output.name: Export-controlled (ITAR) folder access not requestable through portal
output.summary: Engineers joining a program are denied access to export-controlled drawing folders, and their portal folder request is rejected because controlled folders are not covered, forcing a support ticket that takes about two days to resolve.

root_cause.text: Likely the self-service folder access portal has no workflow for export-controlled folders, so every request must be manually routed through a ticket to Trade Compliance screening and then a vault admin.

quotes.quote: Folder request in the portal was rejected; it says controlled folders are not covered.
Routed to Trade Compliance for screening, then access granted by vault admin.

evidence.text: Users explicitly report trying the portal first and being rejected because controlled folders are out of scope.

quotes.quote: Folder request in the portal was rejected; it says controlled folders are not covered.
Folder request in the portal was rejected; it says controlled folders are not covered.

evidence.text: The trigger is routine onboarding: new members of a program team needing controlled models or drawings.

quotes.quote: New on the aerospace program, need to see the controlled models.
I joined the program team and need the controlled drawings folder for panel_599.asm.

evidence.text: Every ticket is resolved the same way, with no denials, showing a repeatable manual two-step process suitable for automation.

quotes.quote: Routed to Trade Compliance for screening, then access granted by vault admin.
Routed to Trade Compliance for screening, then access granted by vault admin.

output.fix: Extend the folder access portal to cover export-controlled folders with a built-in workflow that routes the request to Trade Compliance for screening and, on approval, automatically provisions vault access (ideally triggered when a user is added to a program team), removing the need for a support ticket.
